description: The file defines the class ElasticSearchCommands, which extends Tasks and provides various command methods for interacting with Elasticsearch, such as searching, indexing, and removing indexes within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for performing searches with query syntax, indexing database content with options for differential updates, and utility functions for displaying results and search times.

classes.name: ElasticSearchCommands
classes.description: A class providing commands to perform Elasticsearch operations such as search, index, and remove index within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: elasticSearch
methods.description: Performs a search against Elasticsearch with specified query, size, and output format.

methods.name: elasticIndex
methods.description: Indexes the database into Elasticsearch, either fully or differentially, using specified documentifier types.

methods.name: printModuleResults
methods.description: Outputs the search results for a module, either as JSON or plain text.
